text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
That carbonara zosui in the video looked 
so good... Craft would definitely love it 
too.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I should make this for our next late-night 
snack... No. You've been staying up late 
lately, so rather than a snack, I need to 
make sure you get proper sleep.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It's great to get immersed in 
handcrafting, but I do hope you take care 
of your body.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, maybe I should air out her futon. 
Craft loves the smell of sunshine, after 
all.
